title: Front-end styling and high-end feel mentions
summary: This topic loosely combines front-end appearance or height comments with high-end interior and electronics impressions, while many fragments use the keywords incidentally and do not form a single clear theme.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention high-end electronics and interior feel, and one also praises the car’s overall appearance despite criticizing the front-end styling.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the front end lowering into a barrier and frustration when planned charging stops turn out to be non-functional.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly incidental uses of words like end, high-end, or front end, with only scattered references to storage, phone connection, seat recognition, and front-end ride height.

limitations: The topic is lexically noisy and mixes unrelated subjects rather than a single coherent customer issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so concrete sentiment patterns are limited.
Some examples contain only partial phrases, which restricts interpretation.
